links.outcome: Hallucination rates of LLM clinical decision recommendations in complex cases
links.effect: Deepseek-R1 6/80 (8%) and GPTo1 5/80 (6%) lowest; GPT-4o 7/80 (9%), Kimi 10/80 (12%); Gemini and LLaMa3 13/80 (16%) to 25/80 (31%).
links.quote: Deepseek-R1 and GPTo1 demonstrated the lowest hallucination rates-6/80 (8%) and 5/80 (6%), respectively-significantly outperforming GPT-4o (7/80, 9%), Kimi (10/80, 12%), and the Gemini and LLaMa3 models, which exhibited substantially higher rates ranging from 13/80 (16%) to 25/80 (31%).

unlisted_practices: Comparing LLM decision time and cost against multidisciplinary team experts

screen.reason: The study retrospectively evaluates the accuracy, efficiency, and hallucination rates of various LLMs on 80 complex clinical cases compared to expert clinicians, without testing a specific deployment practice or guardrail.
